card.name: "ranges" after creatinine clearance (pemetrexed NSAID warning)
card.fires_on: The word "ranges" right after "creatinine clearance" in the NSAID and pemetrexed interaction warning for patients with renal impairment. It is followed by "from 45 to 79".

modes.label: Pemetrexed interaction sentence
modes.description: The word "ranges" follows "creatinine clearance" in the NSAID and pemetrexed intervention text.
modes.example: information). Intervention: During concomitant use of piroxicam capsules and pemetrexed, in patients with renal impairment whose creatinine clearance<< ranges>> from 45 to 79

card.plain: It fires on the word "ranges" in the standard warning about NSAIDs given with pemetrexed in kidney impairment.
